tips.text: Buy the first Mire at whatever roll is up, then fuse later; a low roll is never wasted.
Reach Mastery Rank 17 before a good roll shows; players banked Heartcells at MR 14 to 16 and watched 53.7% and 60% rolls rotate out.
Watch the subreddit or the wiki's player-reported table for rotation posts so you catch a high Mire roll.
Bring Revenant, Nyx, Valkyr, Nokko or Dante to the Concert; shield-gating frames die to the band's Toxin.
Kill DJ RoM first in a Duet; his Toxin skips shields.
Run Immuno Shield and Instant Secure (+15% each) once you know the Antivirus; that is 35% per stab, three stabs from zero.
Abort right after a correct-Antivirus stab; the progress banks immediately.
If the stadium keeps killing you, join a public squad; it carries you and pays one extra Heartcell per Coda.
Leave a Coda-controlled mission at about five minutes if no Duet has shown.
Skip Quick Correct; a 10% chance at one Heartcell rarely beats running another Coda.
Wait for the vanquish Heartcells in your inbox; relog if you only got the squad bonus.
Restart the Concert if a band member spawns invisible and the frontman keeps reviving.
Don't fail a Duet mission; it resets the escalating spawn chance, and completed nodes leave the pool until your next correct stab.
Expect one to two hours per Coda; players call it the easiest adversary system.
Run the Antivirus Bounty on Steel Path for extra standing.
